meta.description: SANSA.Query evaluator coverage over host-neutral binding fixtures.

tests.description: Evaluator filters candidate bindings and projects scalar fields.
Evaluator accepts promoted SANSA position range selectors in query sources.
Open-ended position ranges select through the final exposed positional child.

Evaluator applies stable order by before offset and limit.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
order by .qty desc
offset 1
limit 2
select .sku

tests.description: String ordering and relational comparison use deterministic Unicode scalar-value order, not host locale collation.

input.source:
from $.labels.*
where .value >= "z"
order by .value asc
select .value

tests.description: Budget exhaustion after source resolution is an evaluation failure, not implicit truncation.

input.source:

tests.description: absent returns true when the resolution expression resolves zero bindings.
isNullReason tests explicit null values without matching missing bindings.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.status) and isNullReason(.status, "notSet")
select .sku

tests.description: absent tests missing bindings and does not match explicit null values.
isNull is a scalar value test and reports missing when its operand resolves no bindings.
isValue matches concrete values.
isValue returns false, rather than a missing diagnostic, when its operand resolves no bindings.
isValue excludes NaN while accepting finite numbers and infinity as concrete values.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where isValue(.metric) or isValue(.ceiling)
select .sku

tests.description: isValue requires a single binding when its operand is present.
isValue accepts concrete expression results, including literals.
isNaN tests explicit NaN values without relying on equality comparison.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.metric) and isNaN(.metric)
select .sku

tests.description: Semantic filters match the base of generic null datatype claims before null predicates inspect the value.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.status#null) and isNullReason(.status, "notSet")
select .sku

tests.description: Semantic filters match the base of generic NaN datatype claims before NaN predicates inspect the value.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.metric#nan) and isNaN(.metric)
select .sku

tests.description: isInfinity tests explicit Infinity values.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.ceiling) and isInfinity(.ceiling)
select .sku

tests.description: Semantic filters match the base of generic Infinity datatype claims before Infinity predicates inspect the value.

input.source:
from $.inventory.items.*
where exists(.ceiling#infinity) and isInfinity(.ceiling)
select .sku
